scope: CPU-only packaged retrieval; request-local resource-validation reuse; no ranking/content changes or downstream agent efficacy claim

queries.relevance: weight loading mmap checkpoint peak memory

secondary_limits.p95_note: Twenty samples is a noisy sampled tail, not a production SLO estimate; failures remain failures, no post-hoc gate relaxation

measurement.order: even zero-based groups AB, odd groups BA; A baseline, B candidate
measurement.isolation: sequential child process per arm/group, same Python executable and host; do not run other benchmark workers concurrently
measurement.reused_reader: new KnowledgeReader per mode/query, one unmeasured identical invocation, then one measured invocation
measurement.fresh_reader: KnowledgeReader construction plus first collect measured, no explicit warmup; fresh reader is not cold OS filesystem cache
measurement.cli: one complete subprocess per mode/group including interpreter start and stdout capture; no explicit warmup; same query/mode/limit with no filters as paired API (Collect CLI has no repo filter); decoding timed separately
measurement.summary: p50 median; p95 nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n); retain every raw observation including slow samples
measurement.primary_group_statistic: median of four paired query relative reductions 100*(baseline-candidate)/baseline; final statistic median across20 groups
measurement.confidence_interval: percentile bootstrap of20 group statistics,10000 resamples,random.Random(255),2.5th/97.5th percentiles; group is resampling unit
measurement.failure: No trimming, cherry picking or retry pooling. Incomplete run is INCONCLUSIVE. Complete gate miss is FAIL. Preserve failed attempts separately. Stop measurement if source or corpus changes.
measurement.integrity: Record exact source/corpus hashes before and after; baseline/candidate corpus hashes must match. Record serialized output SHA256/bytes for every sample; full outputs retained for correctness run. Require paired output equality. No cache across requests or readers.

accuracy.heldout_policy: Independent reviewer creates4 distinct intent-family cases without running search. Labels unavailable to implementer until candidate code freeze; no tuning on heldout outcomes.
accuracy.interpretation: Partial labels are not exhaustive relevance ground truth or complete Recall. Same result before/after is no accuracy gain. Report each failure and coverage boundary. No model judge or downstream task-effect measurement.
accuracy.candidate_gate: Efficiency-only candidate preserves every semantic/contract output and passes all contract checks; heldout labels assess baseline capability, not tuned to claim an improvement. Any later accuracy change needs a separate prospective protocol/variant.
accuracy.delivery_denominator: Report complete delivery conditional on retrieved relevant items, separately from missed relevant items and intentional budget omission.
